roundReason:
Tester's fail at 733ebfdb (R3): round 6 wrote an image title's line feed as 
 in list items and block quotes, where the base writes it raw and it reads back as held (lazy continuation), so stored documents churned (differential churn 12, lost fixed points 4); red test TestRenderKeepsAStoredImageTitlesLineFeedInAListItemOrBlockQuote (47d7f3f1). Fix ad3351ac5a56a18175caef51d16d0c5acb1cd7da: a title's line feed is written as the base writes it (raw) wherever that reads back as held in the whole document, judged by reading the rendered document back and comparing every image in order; the image with a raw title at or before the first misread image is written again with 
, until every image reads back; a heading or table cell never holds one. The generated test now checks the no-churn property (byte-identical to the base wherever the base's bytes read back as held through Parse, ParseForWrite and the engine) beside the inverse property for every row. Gate change e8dbdc4c609229c4a0ccd7b6c43055a8c17e5274: the differential's churn and engine-tree churn gates count only base bytes ParseForWrite also reads back as held; the 2 rows whose raw CR title a write reads as a line feed (decoding-r4:img-title-cr-ref, decoding-r4:img-title-crlf-ref) are listed ungated as 'churn of base bytes a write reads otherwise' - the architect confirmed this definition (Envoy reply 6147063c, 2026-10-26T10:51Z). Then GitHub reported CONFLICTING: forward merge of main 383b889d903e as 999f2d4b98c7060dc38f0b90c69c29abdb6d19b3 (contracts CHANGELOG conflict only; fingerprint bae303f4... unchanged, https://github.com/sjawhar/legion/pull/2204#issuecomment-6414220003). Previous round: Tester's fail at code head 18e75646 (R2): decodedTitleSuffix wrote a decoded title's line feed raw, so a link title holding a blank line, or any line break in a heading or a table cell, broke its block and the write was refused, a write the base takes; red test TestParseTakesALinkedImageWhoseLinkTitleHoldsALineBreak (0c119da9). The architect also named two image-title shapes the base already refuses (a blank line in an image title, a line break in an image title in a table cell) as the same defect. Fix 733ebfdbd51b2e227203bbd0a71ff6cabc761900: a title's line feed (image title and link title) stays raw only in a top-level paragraph where the image read alone reads back with its titles, so stored titles keep their bytes; in every other block, or when it would not read back, every line feed of both titles is written 
. The generated reader/writer inverse test now covers each field in every block context the writer emits against every character class a context cannot hold raw. Previous round: Generation 3 resumption (plan.json resumption, dispatch://INFRA-190/comment/211c1734-84f9-41ac-b119-9f006b3344de): GitHub reported PR #2204 CONFLICTING at eb1f2266. Forward merge of main@origin 748e8d952a76 into legion/INFRA-190 as merge commit 18e756469fe4cc53056f32750f035a737b55ae84; the only conflict was packages/contracts/CHANGELOG.md (both sides' Unreleased '### Added' bullets kept). No other edit; no admission-query fix to main's tests was needed (every go test package passed). GitHub now reports MERGEABLE. Previous round: Tester's fail at 48eebf71: round 3's src decoder made an image whose source escapes a reference's '&' a refused write (R2; red test TestParseTakesAnImageWhoseSourceEscapesAReferencesAmpersand, b9246afc). Architect narrowed the round: the red test, and every decoded image field (src, title, link, linkTitle) written by the exact inverse of its decoder, proved by one table-driven test and the differential over every corpus. Fix 437ef2a9e6666914755616f53747fb233f14b2d0; evidence https://github.com/sjawhar/legion/pull/2204#issuecomment-6403346645. Earlier rounds: https://github.com/sjawhar/legion/pull/2204#issuecomment-6402787716, https://github.com/sjawhar/legion/pull/2204#issuecomment-6402092124
